info.name: EPA Air Quality System (AQS) Account Type Codes Allowance Transactions API

params.name: accountType
params.description: Type of allowance account (Facility, General, etc.).

params.name: accountNumber
params.description: The unique identification number of an account.

params.name: facilityId
params.description: The Facility ID code assigned by the Department of Energy's Energy Information Administration. The Energy Information Administration Plant ID code is also referred to as the "ORIS code", "ORISPL code", "Facility ID", or "Facility code", among other names. If a Plant ID code has not been assigned by the Department of Energy's Energy Information Administration, then plant code means a code beginning with "88" assigned by the EPA's Clean Air Markets Division for electronic reporting.

params.name: stateCode
params.description: Two letter abbreviation for the State.

params.name: programCodeInfo
params.description: Statutory or regulatory based options for tracking and reducing air pollution emissions.

params.name: ownerOperator
params.description: The name of any company that owns an allowance account or an affected unit.The name of any company that operates an affected unit.

params.name: transactionBeginDate
params.description: Begin date for a given period of an account's allowance transaction history.

params.name: transactionEndDate
params.description: End date for a given period of an account's allowance transaction history.

params.name: transactionType
params.description: The type of allowance transaction (e.g. initial allocation, private transaction, etc.).

params.name: vintageYear
params.description: Year allowance becomes eligible for use in compliance.
